question: What does the catalog require an organization to do with accounts that are no longer being used?
answer_lines: The catalog requires an organization to disable accounts within an organization-defined time period when the accounts are no longer associated with a user or individual [AC-2(3)]. Additionally, accounts that are no longer required must be notified to account managers and other defined personnel within an organization-defined time period [AC-2]. Accounts are to be created, enabled, modified, disabled, and removed in accordance with organization-defined policy, procedures, prerequisites, and criteria [AC-2].
